reports.title: York Space Systems Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook as of November 12, 2026
section: York Space Systems narrowed its guidance range for the full year 2026 to be in the range of $380 million to $400 million.

We are working on a pipeline of government opportunities worth $14.9 billion, an increase of $3 billion as compared to June 30, 2026. This analysis considers the next two years, and we only included opportunities from potential customers we have spoken to directly.
